description: The authors of a frequency-regulation storage study deposit ten-second French power-system frequency deviations from 2015 through 2019, regulation price series, consumption-mix inputs and a Jupyter notebook that constructs the paper figures. Zenodo lists public HDF5, spreadsheet, notebook and source-archive files. Its rights field says `nosl3.0`, while the public licence text calls itself Non-Profit Open Software License 3.0; source RTE measurements may have separate terms. The series can help calibrate or compare simulations of battery response, regulation losses and market revenues. They are historic French system observations and study inputs, not a live balancing-market feed. The page describes the data-building scripts but the notebook and archives were not downloaded or executed. Exact price field meanings and upstream RTE redistribution rights need checking before reuse. Round one rejected this resource during a water-only search, although it is plainly relevant to electricity infrastructure. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this study package.
licence: Zenodo nosl3.0; public LICENSE.txt names NPOSL-3.0; upstream RTE terms separate
